evidence.dominant_driver: Deputy BOJ Governor Himino warned that delaying monetary tightening risks future inflation overshoot; underlying inflation near 2%, real rates still accommodative. Hawkish but December hike was already expected.

market_expectations.source: Reuters poll reported Oct 21 prior to Himino comments
market_expectations.expected_value: Majority (69%) expects 25bp December BOJ hike to 1.50%
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Economist survey, not traded market-implied odds; avoid interpreting 69% as swap probability.

absorption.reason: Hawkish BOJ trajectory already widely expected in the Reuters poll and prior speeches; cannot establish event-specific price absorption without post-news candles.

observations.NI225: Reuters Asia market article Oct 21 02:10Z showed Nikkei +1.3% BEFORE Himino's 04:27Z remarks, driven by earnings and risk sentiment; no verified post-event candle.
observations.USDJPY: Reuters early Asia report USDJPY 158.33, yen slightly weaker before the remarks; no verified post-event yen response.
observations.JGB: No timestamp-verified Japanese 2Y/10Y response after remarks.
observations.DXY: Previous-session unsynchronized DXY 101.71; not a confirmation.
observations.WTI: Reuters pre-event 03:50Z 99.18 USD; energy inflation headwind.
observations.BRENT: Reuters pre-event 03:50Z 110.38 USD; energy inflation headwind.

local_confirmation.BOJ: Reuters verified Himino's parliamentary remarks on inflation near target and still-accommodative conditions.
local_confirmation.finance_minister: Katayama said wages increasingly drive inflation and government policy aligned with BOJ; Reuters Oct 21; incremental context, not a separate surprise.
local_confirmation.NI225: Nikkei +1.3% and USDJPY 158.33 in Reuters early Asia report before the event; does not prove market response.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecasts start at actual created_at_utc, not the earlier source time. 15m/1h/4h horizons remain fixed. No ACTIONABLE learning because learning_profile.json is empty. Price reaction not verified, so excluded from hit rate.
